description: Redemption Wristguards Level 60 Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Redemption Wristguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Wristguards, 6 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 2 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Wristguards - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 6 - Arcanite Bar - Cured Rugged Hide x 2
